labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: what to change
labels.value: Give yourself Campaign Sync. For the people who create appeals, tick Marketing User on their user and let their profile or a permission set create and edit Campaigns.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: Setup path
labels.value: Setup, Users, the person: Marketing User, Permission Set Assignments

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Campaign sync: why it needs Setup
labels.value: A Campaign is created with the access of the person saving the appeal, and Salesforce keeps that access in Setup. Without it the appeal still saves, and Sync all appeals catches it up.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Accounting export: what to change
labels.value: Give the person who runs the export Accounting Export, with a Giving permission set that lets them see gifts (Giving Read Only is enough).

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Accounting export: Setup path
labels.value: Setup, Users, the person, Permission Set Assignments

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Accounting export: why it needs Setup
labels.value: A module's permission set can be assigned only in Setup for now.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: what to change
labels.value: Give yourself Opportunity Mirror. Give fundraising staff Opportunity create and edit access if each gift should get its Opportunity at once.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: Setup path
labels.value: Setup, Users, the person, Permission Set Assignments

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Opportunity mirror: why it needs Setup
labels.value: Opportunities are written with the access of the person saving the gift, which only Setup grants. Without it the nightly run catches them up instead.
